games.imagesHtml: 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗
games.shortDescription: Puzzler meets tower defense in cyberspace.
games.longDescription:
Make yourself comfortable, put on your headphones, and get ready to conquer cyberspace! HexaScape: Cyber Defense is an addictive mix of hex grid puzzler and tower defense mechanics, creating a compelling turn-based strategy game.

- Board game-like mechanics -
If you know the board game classic Carcassonne, you’ll instantly feel at home in HexaScape. Players determine the course of the game by placing hexagon tiles: they explore cyberspace, expand the influence of the cyber core, and build a defense line with towers that can be strengthened and upgraded by power clusters.

As you increase the core’s reach, virus spawners will appear. They spawn viruses and grow stronger with each wave – unless you manage to disable them. Each run feels different: The more you expand into cyberspace, the more abilities the viruses can take on, testing your ability to constantly adapt to new game conditions.

- Build unique towers -
Cyber towers are your only defence against viruses. Place them wisely, buff them with power fields, upgrade them with new abilities by completing quests, and use skill points to customize them to your needs.

- Explore cyberspace -
By placing the hex tiles, you explore cyberspace, encountering six different biomes, many different events, and virus bosses hidden on the generator tiles. There’s a campaign with predefined scenarios, an endless mode with procedurally generated maps, maps of the week, and user-generated maps for nearly endless fun!

- Create your own maps -
Create custom maps for new challenges with the powerful editor! Determine where biomes, event fields, and boss fields are located, and add your own story. Play your maps yourself or share them with the community.

games.imagesHtml: 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗 🔗
games.longDescription:
Welcome to Praslav, a cold Central European city that grows even colder with the coming winter. Praslav is recovering from the political turmoil that followed the end of the Cold War and the fall of the Communist regime, which held the country in its iron grip for decades.

While most people eagerly awaited the coming of democracy and capitalism, some were unable to adapt to the new socio-economic climate. Soon they found themselves on the streets with nowhere to go.

You are one of those people.

In-depths Survival Mechanics:
Keep an eye on your needs and other variables, which interact in realistic ways - staying warm, dry, and well-fed are not your only concerns. Poor hygiene and dirty clothes make you smellier, low temperature increases the risk of falling ill, and whatever piece of food comes in must also come out at some point.

Combat and Crime System:
How far are you willing to go to survive? Steal, burgle, and consort with criminals of all sorts. If necessary, take what you need by force. However, you are not an action hero. Consider your actions carefully, for the consequences are often severe, and benefits rarely outweigh the risks. Most importantly, keep your wits about you. Even if you are not willing to hurt people for personal gain, others are.

Winter is Coming:
Spend the last few days of autumn wisely – gather supplies, equipment, and materials to help you survive the most difficult of seasons. Weather is unpredictable, but there is one certainty - every day is colder than the last. With a lot of preparation and a bit of luck, you might even see the spring again.

Expansive Story:
Unlike other survival games, Hobo: Tough Life leans heavily on its story content. Experience dozens of storylines inspired by real-life events and people. Solve quests, meet unique NPCs, gain their trust, make allies and enemies, join various factions, and find your place in the streets of Praslav.

Homeless, But Not Hopeless:
Maybe there is no warm apartment waiting for you at the end of the day, but you do not have to keep sleeping on park benches either. Find a suitable place and get to work. Construct walls and roofs to shield you from the elements. Gather discarded furniture and curios to furnish your hideout and make it truly your own.

You Are Not Alone:
Is surviving on your own too difficult? Get the gang together. The game supports online co-op multiplayer for up to 4 players. Play alone, together with your friends, or even with total strangers. Team up, collect resources, build a shanty town, survive the winter.

Claim the Throne:
For over a decade, no one has been able to bring the many factions of the homeless together. The throne of the Homeless King has been sitting empty for far too long. Who will earn enough respect and prove themselves worthy of uniting the homeless? Will you rise to the occasion?

games.shortDescription: An action RPG with morality decisions! Relive your past. Fix your mistakes.
games.longDescription:
Hindsight 20/20 - Wrath of the Raakshasa is a 3D third-person action RPG where players can fix mistakes from past playthroughs and relive them for vastly different gameplay and story experiences. Discover the power of morality in each journey where choices and actions have meaningful consequences.

Hindsight 20/20 is founded on five pillars:

1. Choice in Combat:
Decide the fate of two kingdoms as one-armed warrior Jehan. Will he choose to respect the values of his former home by respecting life in all forms? Or will he choose the path of conflict and violence? Before every battle, make the conscious decision to wield a non-lethal stun rod to pacify enemies or a ruthless sword to put them down for good.

2. A Malleable World:
Champaner and its inhabitants switch between several states of disdain or acceptance for Jehan. Each playthrough shows only one version of the world as both the town and its inhabitants experience the effects of Jehan’s choices and actions.

3. Interesting AI and Bosses:
All NPCs react to the world Jehan shapes. Dialogue options and weapon choice are only two factors in how the AI behaves. Hindsight 20/20’s bosses exhibit emotion, making them more relatable. Nuances in their personality come to light as Jehan continues on his journey. The line between good and evil blurs as they react to Jehan.

4. The Experience Engine:
The Experience Engine is a hand-crafted, in-house gameplay engine driven by player choice. This engine is solely responsible for creating the dynamic gameplay and story experiences Jehan witnesses. Every action and choice made is observed and recorded by the Experience Engine leading to a high level of replayability. This feedback loop of choices, actions, and reactions affect the flow of the story and drives the gameplay of Hindsight 20/20.

5. Ten different endings:
Hindsight 20/20 has 10 different endings and four of those endings have absolutely no overlap. Each ending is carefully tailored to the choices and actions made in that journey. And unlocking each ending grants specific trophies as well.

The ultra-popular Japanese VTuber group hololive takes on the world of traditional Japanese card games in Holo's Hanafuda!

■What Is Hanafuda?
Hanafuda, Japanese for "flower cards," are traditional Japanese playing cards beloved by people of all ages. Twelve suits in total make up a deck, with each suit corresponding to a month of the year, and each card decorated with a unique and gorgeous illustration that depicts seasonal imagery matching the card's suit.

●Beginner-Friendly
Holo's Hanafuda comes with a robust suite of helpful features that simplifies play with on-screen markers and tips, making it easy to enjoy an array of hanafuda-based games without memorizing card values and rules.

●A New Twist on Hanafuda
Holo's Hanafuda introduces a brand-new twist on classic hanafuda gameplay with the Holo Awase rule variant! Use a deck of hanafuda cards that feature gorgeous hololive designs, then unleash powerful talent skills by matching cards that show the same hololiver in this koi-koi variant!

●Single-Player Story Mode
Join the hololive members you know and love as they enter a world inspired by hanafuda imagery. This immersive narrative adventure is chock full of banter, battles, and hololive vibes. Plus, it eases you into hanafuda gameplay by teaching you how to play!

●Multiplayer Gameplay
In addition to a healthy helping of single player options, you'll also be able to challenge players from across the globe in thrilling online matches. Pick your game, create a lobby or invite a friend, and hanafuda to your heart's content!

●Create and Share Handmade Bento Boxes
Design custom bento boxes in an in-depth bento mode! Collect points by playing games, then use them to unlock a wide variety of ingredients and decorations that you can mix, match and make bento magic with! Bentos always taste better when shared, so after you design your ideal bento, exchange your culinary creation with other players online!

■Characters
●Nakiri Ayame
“Greetings, Humans! Yoohoo!”
A kimono-clad Oni girl from the Underworld Academy. As she loves to prank people, she always uses will-o’-the-wisp on them just to have fun. Many may not realize it, but she is actually the president of the student council.

●Ookami Mio
“Hellooowl! It is Ookami Mio!”
A black-haired wolf girl who appeared on our radar randomly. She often shows up around shrines. She likes gaming.

●Sakura Miko
“Nya-hello~! I'm Sakura Miko, an elite shrine maiden-idol!”
A shrine maiden from the Virtual Sakura Shrine. With a vivid admiration for idols, she constantly pushes herself to greater heights to become a top elite shrine maiden-idol like no other!
Well... a self-proclaimed 'elite,' to be exact. Fans would think "clutz" fits her better...

...and more!

■Story
One otherwise normal day, hololive members Ayame, Fubuki, Mio, and Miko are suddenly drawn into a mysterious world full of hanafuda imagery. Soon, strange, shadowy figures appear to challenge the four to a series of high-stakes card battles that will decide the girls' fates! But hey, it's not all danger and darkness in hanafuda land—our heroines will also meet friends and allies along the way in this entirely original hololive hanafuda story!

Horror Night: TUNG TUNG TUNG SAHUR
Your car broke down. Middle of the forest. No signal. You spot a creepy mansion up the hill. You knock. No answer. Just as you turn to leave—CREAK—the door opens by itself.

- You step in.
- Bad idea.

Now you’re trapped. No windows open. No doors unlock. But something is inside. And it’s not happy.

From the shadows, you hear it:

He’s coming. He’s got games. And you’re the main player.

- Explore a Haunted Mansion full of traps, cursed hallways, and too many basements.

There’s only one rule in this mansion: Play the game, or the game plays you.
And remember…
TUNG.
TUNG.
TUNG. SAHUR.

You knocked. Now you’re stuck.
Good luck.
